name: Every tool call has a start and an end
prose: a tool call the engine refuses before it can run — a switched-off tool, an unknown tool, arguments cut off mid-JSON, input that fails the schema, a permission denial — still sends `tool_call_started` before its `tool_call_finished`, so every frontend draws a row for it and pairs the two.
invariant: Every tool_call_finished is preceded by a tool_call_started for the same call, including the calls refused before they run.
